reasons.plausibility: Using a niobium interlayer to reduce Cr–Zr diffusion aligns well with established diffusion barrier concepts, making it scientifically credible.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparative experiment with clear performance metrics would decisively show if Nb addition reduces Cr–Zr interdiffusion and improves coating integrity.
reasons.usefulness: This approach directly addresses a key challenge in zirconium-alloy fuel cladding, offering a clear, testable path to enhance high-temperature performance.
